title: Token swatches
description: The semantic tokens of one foundation, each drawn as its own value. Drawn by the TokenSwatches composite at the top of a Foundations page.

tokens.description: Every token of the foundation that has a drawing, in the scheme's order.

token.description: The token's path, such as color.neutral.0.

kind.description: What the value is, which sets how it is drawn: a fill, a corner, a border width, a length and so on.

value.description: The CSS value drawn: the token's CSS variable, or its own value when it has none.

note.description: A line height in pixels, shown beside a leading drawing.
